plan.title: Add + button to directives in VSCode plugin similar to TASKS which triggers festina-directive
plan.overview: Add a [+] button to the DIRECTIVES section header by: (1) defining the createDirective command in package.json with $(add) icon, (2) adding a view/title menu contribution for the festinalenteDirectives view, (3) injecting terminal orchestrator into directives orchestrator, and (4) registering the command to execute /festina-directive. This follows the exact pattern established by TASKS and QUICKS sections.

approach.rationale:
Following three existing patterns: - Header button definition: package.json:96-98 (festinalente.createTask with $(add) icon) - Menu contribution: package.json:144-149 (view/title with when clause for hasFestinalenteFolder) - Terminal injection: tasks.orchestrator.ts:26-29 (terminal dependency pattern) - Command registration: tasks.orchestrator.ts:264-277 (registerCommand with executeInTerminal)
Unlike TASKS/QUICKS, no title prompt is needed - /festina-directive handles its own Q&A workflow.

task.name: Add createDirective command definition to package.json
task.action:
- Add new command object to contributes.commands array - Use command: "festinalente.createDirective" - Use title: "Festina Lente: Create Directive" - Use icon: "$(add)"
Pattern to follow (approximate): ```json { "command": "festinalente.createTask", "title": "Festina Lente: Create Task - Capture problem, value, and acceptance criteria", "icon": "$(add)" } ```
Add after refreshQuicks command (around line 141): ```json { "command": "festinalente.createDirective", "title": "Festina Lente: Create Directive", "icon": "$(add)" } ```
task.done: Command definition added to package.json commands array

task.name: Add view/title menu contribution for directives view
task.action:
- Add new menu entry to contributes.menus.view/title array - Use command: "festinalente.createDirective" - Use when: "view == festinalenteDirectives && festinalente.hasFestinalenteFolder" - Use group: "navigation@1" (leftmost position)
Pattern to follow (approximate): ```json { "command": "festinalente.createTask", "when": "view == festinalenteTasks && festinalente.hasFestinalenteFolder", "group": "navigation@1" } ```
Add after existing directives-related menu entries or at end of view/title array: ```json { "command": "festinalente.createDirective", "when": "view == festinalenteDirectives && festinalente.hasFestinalenteFolder", "group": "navigation@1" } ```
task.done: Menu contribution added with correct when clause and navigation@1 position

task.name: Add terminal dependency to directives orchestrator
task.done: Terminal dependency added to deps interface, registerCommands added to return interface

task.name: Implement registerCommands in directives orchestrator
task.done: createDirective command registered, executes /festina-directive in terminal

task.name: Wire terminal to directives orchestrator in extension.ts
task.done: Terminal orchestrator wired to directives orchestrator, registerCommands called

task.name: Final verification
task.action: - Reload VSCode window - Verify [+] button appears in DIRECTIVES section header - Click [+] button - Verify terminal opens and runs /festina-directive command - Complete directive creation workflow - Verify DIRECTIVES section refreshes to show new directive
task.done: All acceptance criteria pass - button visible, terminal executes /festina-directive

testing.automated: None required - straightforward wiring, build verification is sufficient
testing.manual: - Click [+] button on DIRECTIVES header, verify /festina-directive runs in terminal - Verify button only appears when .festinalente folder exists - Complete directive creation, verify DIRECTIVES section refreshes (existing file watcher handles this)
testing.regression: Verify existing TASKS and QUICKS [+] buttons still work correctly

edge-cases.case: Terminal stays open, no harm done - directive skill handles gracefully

pitfalls.pitfall: Must add terminal to deps AND call registerCommands in extension.ts

pitfall.issue: Wrong view ID in when clause
